releases.author: Kpyruy
releases.description:
## See the whole note

Tree Overview turns every Arbor note into a calm, connected map of its complete structure. Pan across the tree, zoom out to 50%, and work directly inside rendered Markdown cards.

![Tree Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kpyruy/Arbor/0.2.4/assets/tree-overview.png)

### Highlights

- **Full-tree overview** — every block, parent-child connection, and branch in one spatial view.
- **Rendered Markdown cards** — headings, emphasis, lists, links, and other Markdown stay fully rendered in every card.
- **Edit in place** — double-click a card to edit it without leaving the overview.
- **Full right-click menu** — every Overview card has the same create, navigate, copy, duplicate, reveal, and delete actions as the branch editor.
- **Smooth keyboard navigation** — arrows, child numbers, and Ctrl/Cmd + arrows move through the tree; Delete keeps keyboard focus in Overview, so navigation continues immediately.

### No flashes while building

Creating a block with Ctrl/Cmd + an arrow keeps the current tree visible while Arbor prepares and measures the new layout. Markdown is rendered in full before the new map replaces the old one.

### Polish and compatibility

- More stable card sizing and spacing for long content.
- A lighter, smoother overview zoom and cleaner controls.
- Release notice introducing Tree Overview after updating.
- Fixed Obsidian API review warnings while retaining support from Obsidian 1.7.2.

### Install

Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` below into your vault at `.obsidian/plugins/arbor/`, then reload Obsidian.

## Arbor 0.2.3

This release makes Arbor notes easier to understand, navigate, share, and move back into normal Markdown when needed.

### What’s new

- **Readable Arbor structure** — saved notes now include a clear structure footer, and older notes are migrated automatically.
- **ARBOR label in File Explorer** — managed notes are easier to recognise at a glance.
- **Clean Markdown export** — create a separate, clean copy of a note and choose whether to keep YAML frontmatter.
- **Copy block link** — copy a link that opens the exact Arbor block you want to share.
- **Numeric child navigation** — type a child number to move through a branch, or press `0` to return to the parent block.

### Refined interaction

- **New arbor note** now lives in the File Explorer creation area for folders and empty space, without appearing in a file menu.
- Switching to **Open in Markdown** no longer immediately routes managed notes back into Arbor.
- Export controls and File Explorer labels have been refined for a calmer, clearer experience.

Requires Obsidian `1.7.2` or newer.

Arbor 0.2.0 focuses on reliable structure recovery and a cleaner opening flow.

- Notes now store precise visible block markers while keeping hidden Arbor metadata.
- Legacy Arbor notes upgrade automatically to the new format when opened.
- Managed notes open through a dedicated Arbor loading view instead of flashing the standard markdown view.
- Auto-open rules are stricter, so marker-like snippets in normal notes are no longer hijacked.
- Added `New arbor note`, predictable untitled numbering, and improved main-pane opening behavior.
